crossRefs.note: Jesus returned in the power of the Spirit into Galilee, and news about him spread through all the surrounding area.
Behold, my servant will deal wisely. He will be exalted and lifted up, and will be very high.
Jesus went about in all Galilee, teaching in their synagogues, preaching the Good News of the Kingdom, and healing…
The report of this went out into all that land.
The report of him went out immediately everywhere into all the region of Galilee and its surrounding area.
But he went out, and began to proclaim it much, and to spread about the matter, so that Jesus could no more openly…
King Herod heard this, for his name had become known, and he said, “John the Baptizer has risen from the dead, and…

translations.web: News about him went out into every place of the surrounding region.
translations.bsb: And the news about Jesus spread throughout the surrounding region.
translations.kjv: And the fame of him went out into every place of the country round about.
translations.asv: And there went forth a rumor concerning him into every place of the region round about.
